name: How long does a typical kitchen renovation project take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen renovation project take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen renovation varies significantly based on its complexity, the extent of structural changes, and the lead time for custom materials. While minor updates might take a few weeks, a full kitchen renovation, including custom cabinetry and layout modifications, can range from 8 to 16 weeks or more from design finalization to completion. Our integrated design-build process ensures permit coordination and a clear project timeline from the outset, providing transparency throughout the managed process. Clients should factor in material selection time, as unique finishes can impact the overall schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovations typically take 8 to 16 weeks, varying with complexity and custom material lead times. AKN provides clear timelines and handles permit coordination.
